history.event: Claude refinement: 36 line(s) suggested — I corrected garbled words from the page's formulas (carta ꝑ mano, notto fiorētino, donagione, gabella, borteghino, Io vendei, dagosto), fixed the misread figures and the lira sign (𝓎 235, 𝓎 74, a di 10) and marked the struck-through text with [del: ]. | layout: l1, l2: marginal title (lacasa / da lad̄ta di sotto) beside the l6–l8 entry; by house rule it goes before that section.; l15: interlinear addition in lighter ink above l16 (caret below it, after 'adi 9'), probably a date correction; could be encoded as [ins: …] in l16.; l17: the box takes in the marginal title 'lacasa dela piazuola' with the first line of the entry; the title should be its own line before l16.; l21: tiny box over the first (struck?) sign of l22; it is a fragment of l22 and should be merged or deleted.; l29, l30: marginal title 'elborteghino da ꝑtovechio' beside the l31–l36 entry; it belongs before that section.; l31, l32: one manuscript line ('Ricordo chome adi di … 14 Io vendei agiordani'), split by a blank space left for the date; consider merging.; l35: the opening 'ꝑ' and part of 'p̄gio' sit left of the box outline.; l37: empty box over a stray mark at the foot of the page; no text. Delete it.; l38: the box covers only the flourish before the folio number '38'; the number itself is outside the box. | doubts: l3: the struck word after ibeni looks like 'mobili'; 'ini mobili iqli' is left as read and needs checking.; l5: 'panei' is unclear (maybe 'ꝯ miei'); I left it as Kraken read it.; l8: the final sign could be 𝒹 or an etc. abbreviation; there is no sum here.; l9/l10: the end of l9 and the start of l10 ('a' / 'ꝯmanotto') and the phrase 'e ī scanbi' are uncertain.; l16: the year's second and third figures look alike (1443 or 1453?); compare with 1463 in l5.; l18, l35: the lira is written y-like + 'tt'; I used 𝓎 per the conventions. Is the 'tt' part of the sign? The sign after 235 (ß?) is uncertain.; l13, l14, l36: personal names (nerlolo, nucio, madeo) are guesses; the 'fi' at the end of l36 is probably fiorentino abbreviated, not the florin sign.; l26: the struck opening signs could not be read.; l28: 'o ꝓ ī sto' could not be resolved; I left it as read.
